user.title: Add Monster speaker
user.description: Pick a speaker Home Assistant can hear, or enter its Bluetooth MAC address (for example 00:11:22:33:44:55). Close the Monster app first so the speaker is free to connect.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add Monster speaker
bluetooth_confirm.description: Add the discovered speaker {name} to Home Assistant?

error.device_not_seen: Home Assistant has not seen a connectable device at this address yet. Make sure the speaker is on and the Monster app is closed.

abort.unsupported_device: This device is not a supported Monster speaker.
